title: Book Two · Chapter 124: No New Pair
story:
Near the end of the term, Miss Wu asks pupils to plan one small reading display. They can work alone or with a partner.

Ronan chooses three short stories about things in the wrong place. He wants to show the first place and the last place with little arrows. He takes his idea to Jun.

“I can do the words,” he says. “You could make the cards.”

Jun closes his book.

“I have a plan.”

“With someone?”

“Yes.”

Ronan still wants Jun to choose him.

“We used to do these things together.”

Jun puts his book on the desk.

“Yes.”

“I am checking the words now.”

“I see that.”

“Then why—”

Jun looks at him. Ronan stops.

“I do not want to check your promise each time,” Jun says. “I want to work on my page.”

The words are quiet. Two nearby pupils keep reading. Nobody gathers around them. Jun waits for Ronan's answer.

“Will you never work with me?”

“I am talking about this display.”

Ronan nods. He takes his three stories back to his own table.

He cuts six plain cards. On the first pair he draws a chair in two rooms. On the second he draws a cup. On the third he leaves a blank space because he has not finished the story.

Leo stops beside him.

“Where is the third thing?”

“I do not know yet.”

“A very small invisible parcel?”

Ronan smiles. “I need to read the end.”

“Start with that, then.”

Leo goes to his own display. Ronan reads the third story carefully. A girl brings a basket from the yard into the kitchen. Later her brother takes it outside again. The final place is under the back step.

Ronan draws a step. It looks like a chair lying down. He turns the card over and starts again.

Mei passes and points at his pencil.

“Use the ruler for the edge.”

“Can you show me once?”

She draws one short edge on a spare piece. He follows it on his own card.

By the afternoon, all three pairs are ready. Miss Wu asks him to explain the third one. He names the girl, the brother, and the last place.

She lets him put the cards on the display shelf.

Jun's work stands on the other side. Ronan looks at it. He keeps his hands beside him. Then he moves his own last card a little higher. A younger pupil can now see the basket below the step. He sits down and watches her follow the arrow with her finger.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

display＝展示；invisible＝看不见的；edge＝边缘；partner＝搭档。

## 理解问题

1. Jun说他不想在合作中反复做什么？
2. Ronan最后怎样完成自己的展示？

## 读句子

**He / cuts / six plain cards.** 他／裁出／六张空白卡片。
